about: Every tap flips a light and the four next to it. Turn the whole board dark in as few moves as you can. Puzzles always have a solution. Easy 4x4, Normal 5x5, Hard 6x6.
controls: Tap a light. Undo, Hint and Restart buttons on the right.
name: Lights Out
tagline: Tap a light to flip it and its neighbours. Turn them all off.
